CHROMIUM: mali: HACK: add backward compatibility for r12 userspace GPUCORE-14339: Make r22p0 backwards compatible This re-introduces the old UK 10.6 support (which includes support for earlier 10.x versions). We had to back out the Kari support as it broke pre-r18p0 clients due to a change in a prop query structure r18 added support was not fixed. So pre-r18 clients expects a static property query and thus can't handle adding new Kari properties. BUG=b:73501174 TEST=build and run daisy, peach, minnie and kevin Change-Id: I89fd6521e367bebb223e1b04aa1077b348253d10 Signed-off-by: Dominik Behr <dbehr@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/957586 Reviewed-by: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org>

power_ProbeDriver: refactor to use SysStat This test pre-dates the SysStat object being created which unifies power supply query & checking. Refactor the test to use it. Note, the refactor removes the notion of CrOS devices having multiple batteries that should be checked. May need to revisit this if detachables have batteries in both lid & base and both are presented to sysfs. BUG=chromium:820588 TEST=power_ProbeDriver.probe_ac power_ProbeDriver.probe_bat Change-Id: I5f6475ec8fd6bbf1acd039da9784561b057cc82e Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/957880 Commit-Ready: Todd Broch <tbroch@chromium.org> Tested-by: Todd Broch <tbroch@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Dan Erat <derat@chromium.org>

cbuildbot_run: Adjust GetVersion to use CIDB Id. A similar CL:869450 was submitted and reverted previously because assorted lab code could not handle the change in the ChromeOS build version string from *-bXXX to *-cXXX. I've given up trying to make the lab more flexible, so this CL keeps the *-bXXX, but changes the meaning of XXX from builder run number to CIDB id. This is still expected to cause issues for the toolchain team until chromium:807029 is fixed. BUG=chromium:800562 TEST=run_tests CQ-DEPEND=CL:954052 Change-Id: I1132f8e2618314f2cdcc8705756394d275f9ce51 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/951915 Commit-Ready: Don Garrett <dgarrett@chromium.org> Tested-by: Don Garrett <dgarrett@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Richard Barnette <jrbarnette@google.com>

cr50-get-name: return cr50.bin.prod if usb_updater -i fails 0.0.13 does not support the vendor command to get the board id. Modify cr50-get-name so it doesn't just fail and stop cr50-update. Make it return cr50.bin.prod. We just need cr50 to update to at least the .prod image, so someone can set the board id. After this cr50-update will update to the correct .prod or .prepvt image based on the board id. BUG=b:73256785 BRANCH=none TEST=manual Install a DBG image on the device. run eraseflashinfo set the board id to ZZAF:0x7f7f rm /var/cache/cr50* rollback to 0.0.13 make sure cr50-update updates the device to the .prod image make sure cr50-get-name then successfully sees the board id is has 0x10 set and cr50-update updates the device to the .prepvt image Change-Id: I438441a41a4382a16e9db0a36fddbd03c9de7bff Signed-off-by: Mary Ruthven <mruthven@google.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/953652 Commit-Ready: Mary Ruthven <mruthven@chromium.org> Tested-by: Mary Ruthven <mruthven@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mary Ruthven <mruthven@chromium.org>

Nami: Disable one USB-C port The TCPC of the left USB-C port is being swapped with Anx7447. This patch temporarily disables the port so that the boot is not inhibited by running a wrong driver on the port. BUG=b:73793947 BRANCH=none TEST=Boot Nami with/without battery. Verify it can be charged through the right port. Change-Id: I30b63f87cb3669c38a04e908b6556eef1424fbd7 Signed-off-by: Daisuke Nojiri <dnojiri@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/957814 Reviewed-by: Furquan Shaikh <furquan@chromium.org>

Stout: fix the GPIO number for rf-led pin The rf-led-handler crashed occasionally at boot up time as WARNING kernel: [ 10.331504] init: rf-led-handler pre-start process (1729) terminated with status 2 This patch fixed the crash by correcting the GPIO number. BUG=chromium:800939 TEST=Build packages and image for stout, cros flash, and reboot. Turn on wifi or bluetooth in the system tray. Checked two things: (1) There should be no crash when grepping the messages log. $ grep "rf-led-handler" /var/log/messages (2) Observe that the green lid led is turned on/off when you enable/disable wifi/bluetooth. Change-Id: Ib033da09c7beb9aba7b93d96e7c655c6b803dcff Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/952944 Commit-Ready: Shyh-In Hwang <josephsih@chromium.org> Tested-by: Shyh-In Hwang <josephsih@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Miao-chen Chou <mcchou@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>
